title: Does a Learned Corrector Beat a Simple Retreat? Evidence from a Frozen VLA
description:
arXiv:2610.06921v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Before deploying runtime recovery for a frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policy, one must establish that an intervention improves success beyond ordinary run-to-run variation and that its complexity adds value over a simple action. We evaluate these questions on frozen $\pi_{0.5}$ across four RoboTwin tasks. For each test seed, we pair rollouts with and without correction and include a same-seed base-policy re-run as a placebo.
